gloss: Buddhist altar fittings; Buddhist ritual implements

definitions.gloss: Buddhist altar fittings; Buddhist ritual implements
definitions.explanation: Objects and utensils used in Buddhist worship, including items placed on a home altar or used in temple ceremonies.

examples.english: To polish the Buddhist altar fittings.

examples.japanese: {仏具|ぶつぐ}{店|てん}で{線香立|せんこうた}てを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought an incense holder at a Buddhist supplies shop.

examples.japanese: {祖母|そぼ}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{仏壇|ぶつだん}の{仏具|ぶつぐ}を{丁寧|ていねい}に{手入|てい}れしてから{手|て}を{合|あ}わせる。
examples.english: Every morning, my grandmother carefully tends to the altar fittings before pressing her hands together in prayer.

notes:
A compound of {仏|ぶつ} (Buddha/Buddhist) and {具|ぐ} (implements/tools). Refers to the various objects used in Buddhist practice, both at home altars ({仏壇|ぶつだん}) and at temples.

Common {仏具|ぶつぐ} items include candlesticks ({燭台|しょくだい}), incense burners ({香炉|こうろ}), flower vases ({花立|はなたて}), bells ({鈴|りん}), and offering dishes. Most Japanese households that maintain a {仏壇|ぶつだん} have a basic set of these items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}{店|てん}: Buddhist supplies shop
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}を{揃|そろ}える: to assemble a set of altar fittings
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}を{磨|みが}く: to polish the altar fittings
- {仏具|ぶつぐ}{一式|いっしき}: a full set of altar fittings

RELATED WORDS:
- {仏壇|ぶつだん}: Buddhist home altar
- {法具|ほうぐ}: ritual implements (broader term including esoteric Buddhist tools)
- {数珠|じゅず}: prayer beads
